# AI-Assisted Writing

The canonical, tool-agnostic writing skill for this repository lives at [`skills/draft-article/SKILL.md`](../../skills/draft-article/SKILL.md). Read and follow it in full before drafting, revising, or translating any Blog or Notes content.

It defines the roles and Cloudflare branch-preview approval gate, author identity and grounding, factual-integrity rules, logic and argumentation requirements, voice and style, the anti-content-farm rules, category conventions, and translation rules. This file exists only so editor integrations that auto-attach `.github/instructions` files pick the skill up; do not add writing rules here.
